A move to Australia has a lot of steps. Take them one at a time.

Open Path helps you understand your options, prepare for the paperwork, and find your feet after you arrive.

Find your starting point Why we started Open Path
Melbourne, Australia

Australia wasn't on our radar either.

One research opportunity opened a door. Then came the applications, the documents, the waiting, the flight, and a hundred small things to learn after landing.

We know what it feels like to piece together a plan from official pages, personal stories, videos, and advice from people who've made the move. Open Path is being built to make that path easier to see, one decision at a time.

See the journey

What does your next step look like?

Moving countries can feel like one enormous decision. It gets easier to work through when you can see the part in front of you.

Start with what matters to you.

Before comparing visas, get clear on who is moving, what you hope to do, and what a move would need to make possible.

Explore official Australian immigration information

A useful place to begin

  • Write down your reason for considering Australia
  • List who would be part of the move
  • Keep official requirements separate from personal stories
